decision: No first-party Claude payload on this machine currently exposes reset-offer/campaign metadata, and the CLI is not logged in to fetch one. Per T-1360 rule 8, no vendor campaign key is hard-coded. Implementation ships a GENERIC defensive campaign parser (explicit availability evidence required; null/absent metadata never means available) applied to the first-party payloads FastPrompter already reads, so a future payload that does carry offers is surfaced without schema invention. Until such a payload exists, Claude shows no reset offers and no fake zero.
